description: Write an SPF record from the providers that send for a domain (with an estimate of its DNS lookups against the limit of 10), a DMARC record from a policy, and where a provider publishes DKIM. Returns host, type and value to publish. It writes records; to check what is published, use check_spf, check_dmarc and check_dkim.

dkimProvider.description: A provider to get DKIM setup steps for, e.g. "Google Workspace".

dmarcPct.description: Percentage the policy applies to. Defaults to 100.

dmarcPolicy.description: Ask for a DMARC record with this policy. p=none is fine for cold email.

dmarcRua.description: Address for aggregate reports, e.g. dmarc@example.com.

spfAll.description: Policy for unlisted senders. Defaults to ~all.

spfMx.description: Add the mx mechanism. Defaults to false.

spfProviders.description: Providers that send for the domain, e.g. ["Google Workspace", "SendGrid"].

name: generate_dns_records
title: SPF and DMARC record generator
